ruleset.name: Template Custom Rules
ruleset.description: Reference PMD ruleset for Salesforce projects. Covers Apex, Visualforce, XML metadata, and JavaScript (ECMAScript). Includes custom XPath rules for Salesforce-specific governance concerns. Adjust priorities and suppressions to match your organization's risk posture and coding standards.

rule.name: AltTextOnImages
rule.message: Always use an 'alt' attribute for images
rule.description: All images require alt text for accessibility compliance.

rule.name: DeclareAccessOnMethods
rule.message: Explicitly use public/private/protected/global on Apex methods
rule.description: Declare an explicit access modifier on all non-test methods.

property.name: xpath

rule.name: DoNotUseWithoutSharing
rule.message: Use with sharing or inherited sharing, or document the justification for without sharing
rule.description: Flags any class declared with without sharing. Document the justification in a code comment.

rule.name: RequireExplicitSharing
rule.message: Explicitly declare with sharing, without sharing, or inherited sharing
rule.description: All Apex classes must declare an explicit sharing model. Does not apply to interfaces or enums, which cannot declare sharing.

property.name: xpath

rule.name: RequireOuterClassAccess
rule.message: Specify public, private, or global on outer Apex classes
rule.description: All outer Apex classes must have an explicit access modifier.

property.name: xpath

rule.name: DoNotRunAsCurrentUser
rule.message: Do not execute test methods as the running user - use a dedicated test user instead
rule.description: Test methods must not use System.runAs(UserInfo.getUserId()).

rule.name: ModifyOrViewAllData
rule.message: ViewAllData and ModifyAllData grant unrestricted record access - restrict to System Administrator only
rule.description: Profiles and Permission Sets must not grant ViewAllData or ModifyAllData.

rule.name: ModifyOrViewAllRecordsCustom
rule.message: Use sharing rules to grant record access rather than View All or Modify All on custom objects
rule.description: Profiles and Permission Sets should not grant View All or Modify All Records on custom objects.

rule.name: ModifyOrViewAllRecordsStandard
rule.message: View All or Modify All Records on standard objects bypasses the sharing model - blocking violation
rule.description: Profiles and Permission Sets must not grant View All or Modify All Records on standard objects.

rule.name: ManageUsers
rule.message: Manage Users permissions should be restricted to the System Administrator profile
rule.description: Manage Users is a restricted permission.

rule.name: ViewSetupProfile
rule.message: ViewSetup should be restricted to the System Administrator profile
rule.description: ViewSetup is a restricted permission that must not appear in custom profiles.

rule.name: ViewSetupPermissionSet
rule.message: ViewSetup must not be granted via a Permission Set
rule.description: ViewSetup must not appear in Permission Sets.

rule.name: NonPrivateCustomObjectSharing
rule.message: Custom objects must use Private org-wide default sharing
rule.description: Require Private OWD for all custom objects.

rule.name: NonPrivateStandardObjectSharing
rule.message: Standard objects must not use ReadWrite org-wide default sharing
rule.description: Require non-ReadWrite OWD for standard objects.

rule.name: MetadataDescriptionObjectField
rule.message: Add a description to explain this custom metadata
rule.description: All custom objects and fields must have a description.

rule.name: MetadataDescriptionPermission
rule.message: Add a description to explain what access this metadata grants
rule.description: All Permission Sets, Profiles, Custom Permissions, and Permission Set Groups must have a description.

rule.name: MetadataDescriptionFlow
rule.message: Add a description to explain this Flow's purpose
rule.description: All Flows must have a description.

rule.name: NoHardcodedWeblinkURLs
rule.message: Do not hardcode force.com domain URLs in weblinks
rule.description: Weblink URLs must not contain hardcoded Salesforce instance URLs.

rule.name: BumpApiVersion
rule.message: Metadata is using an outdated API version - update to a recent version
rule.description: Metadata API versions below 58 should be updated.

rule.name: DoNotUseProcessBuilder
rule.message: Process Builder is deprecated - migrate this automation to Flow
rule.description: All Process Builder automations must be migrated to Flow.
